data.title: 拉毗 · 战术端子休眠后的呼吸
data.action: 坐在折叠椅上，一手拉开微敞的黑色睡袍前襟，一手紧扣在战术皮带上，绯红眼眸坚定中浮现出一丝难以自持的羞怯。
data.location: 反击部队野战指挥所单间，关闭的战术全息地图终端在黑暗中沉寂

data.lighting: 桌上一盏军用手电筒泛出的暖白散射光，照亮了紧绷平坦的小腹与利落的军人锁骨
data.mood: 钢铁般坚毅的军人意志与内心深处纯真女性柔情的强烈碰撞
data.description: 反击部队野战指挥所单间，关闭的战术全息地图终端在黑暗中沉寂。坐在折叠椅上，一手拉开微敞的黑色睡袍前襟，一手紧扣在战术皮带上，绯红眼眸坚定中浮现出一丝难以自持的羞怯。 她微微抬眸轻语——“指挥官……作为反击部队的队长，我必须确保您的绝对安全。但作为拉毗个人……请让我今晚陪伴在您左右。”
data.promptProse: Seated straight on the edge of a field cot inside a quiet command bunker at night, Rapi holds her dark sleep robe partly open to reveal a scarlet-and-black carbon-weave sheer tactical bralette with harness straps and high-waist boyshorts. With her beret resting on a nearby crate and a subtle blush softening her steady gaze, she glows under subdued warm lamp light.
data.animaCaption: Seated upright on the edge of her field cot parting her dark robe to reveal a scarlet-and-black tactical sheer bralette and high-waist boyshorts, she meets the viewer's gaze with disciplined composure softening into rare vulnerability. Warm tabletop light cuts clean shadows inside the dark command bunker.
data.nsfwProse: Beneath a parted black sleep robe she wears a structured scarlet-silk and carbon-weave sheer tactical bralette with harness clasps and matching high-waist boyleg briefs.
